bibl.note: Thebes, 30 January 124 BCE. - Introduction - Anastasi's Acquisition. - Content Summary [Chapocrates, one of the six children of Horos and Sachperis, acknowledges to his eldest brother Osoroeris, that he has received from him his part of the inheritance of the family property]. - The Chapocrates Case. - Scribal Flaws? - The Large(r) Archive of Horos and Osoroeris.
